name: Christopher Roberts
biography: Christopher Roberts is a security researcher at REDLattice Inc. He has extensive vulnerability research experience in embedded systems and program analysis frameworks. He competes and speaks in George Mason’s competitive cyber club. He’s known for building several tools which automatically solve and produce flags from pwnable and reversing CTF problems. (Zeratool) (PinCTF) Github: https://github.com/ChrisTheCoolHut
